description: List loaded CWE/CAPEC vocabulary, every CWE view, workflow guidance, or catalog versions and refresh health. Filter requires every whitespace-separated token in an item label, each at a word start or camelCase hump (script finds JavaScript). Tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start; spelling coincidences can match. Omit filter to browse. Platforms distinguishes example code languages from platform names and classes. Follow nextCursor for complete lists; limits above 100 are capped with disclosure.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by this tool.

filter.description: All-token case-insensitive label filter; each token matches at a word start or camelCase hump. Tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start; spelling coincidences can match. Blank means unset.

limit.description: Maximum page size; capped at 100 and a 24,000-byte response budget with disclosure.

topic.description: views lists CWE view IDs; abstraction_levels explains CWE and CAPEC levels; mitigation_phases lists prevention phases; platforms lists platform dimensions and exampleLanguages; relationship_natures lists relation labels; filter_values lists statuses, consequence impacts, CWE mapping usage, CWE taxonomy names, severity, and likelihood; workflow explains navigation; versions reports catalog freshness and refresh health.

name: cwe_list_reference

catalogs.description: Both loaded catalog health records; versions only.

fetchedAt.description: When the served catalog was downloaded from MITRE; absent for a cached copy with no matching download record.

lastRefreshError.description: Refresh failure retaining last good data.

source.description: Where the served catalog came from: cache is a saved copy loaded at start and not downloaded again since; upstream is a download by this server process.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is modified, stale, or incompatible with the normalized query. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

description.description: View objective or explanation, in CommonMark.

filterDefinition.description: Source XPath filter that defines a filter-defined view’s membership in place of recorded members, exactly as published.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same normalized query.

truncated.description: Whether the page limit omitted matching items.

title: List CWE and CAPEC reference values
